assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mxfp4 routed experts (moe_backend "") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_2rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
